Class PaginatedPostRequest<T>

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.request.EquinixRequest<T>
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.request.PaginatedPostRequest<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the operation's model type
public final class PaginatedPostRequest<T> extends EquinixRequest<T>
Request carrier for POST-based search operations whose paging state lives in the request body (a PaginatedPostBody) rather than in offset/limit query parameters. The paging pipeline advances the body's pagination between pages; because the wire entity is rebuilt from the RequestBody at every dispatch, the advanced offset is re-serialized automatically.

ianjones
